Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and checklist. Short answer: yes on region pinning, and we have a documented tenant-scoped wipe pathway with audit artifacts.

I pulled in Dev (runtime) and Marissa (solutions) to give concrete artifacts and expected timelines. High level: a Dedicated capacity reservation is bound to a single region by default. Backup snapshots are stored in the same region unless a customer explicitly enables cross-region replication (opt-in). For tenant erasure we produce:
- operation ticket and timeline
- snapshot deletion logs and storage object delete markers
- service-level audit entries (who invoked, which job id)
- KV/cache purge confirmation and rolling restart notes

We can share a short diagram and the runbook. Dev — can you provide the time-to-erase estimate and exact artifact file names we should return to Magnatech? Marissa — will follow up on the SOW wording re: opt-in replication.

Kimberly Park

Hi all — technical details below (summarized for Alice):

1) Region anchoring: Dedicated pools are created in a single AWS region and we do not perform cross-region replication for customer datasets unless a customer enables "geo-backups" at provisioning. The control plane (customer metadata) can remain in our control plane region, but production data for Dedicated instances is pinned to the chosen region.

2) Tenant-scoped wipe pathway (steps & artifacts):
- Step 0 (auth): customer submits a verified wipe request via portal/secure ticket + signed authorization (DocuSign).
- Step 1 (freeze): we quiesce the tenant traffic and snapshot application state (if requested). Artifact: freeze-ticket-<ticket-id>.json (audit).
- Step 2 (kv & cache purge): remove tenant keys from KV store and flush caches. Artifact: kv-deletes-<ticket-id>.log.
- Step 3 (storage object deletion): run idempotent delete job against tenant buckets and blobs. Artifact: storage-delete-manifest-<ticket-id>.csv (S3 delete markers).
- Step 4 (snapshot purge): delete any region-scoped snapshots/scheduled backups. Artifact: snapshot-delete-audit-<ticket-id>.json.
- Step 5 (metadata scrub & index rebuild): scrub tenant indices, and run consistency checks. Artifact: metadata-scrub-report-<ticket-id>.html.
- Step 6 (verify & close): security reviews artifacts and issues closure token; we provide final report. Artifact: final-erase-report-<ticket-id>.pdf.

Estimated maximum elapsed time: for medium-sized tenants (10s of GBs) the full process completes within 48 hours from verified request; for large tenants (TBs) it can take up to 7 days depending on snapshot size and retention policies. We will provide incremental artifacts as each step completes.

Evidence we can hand over: signed ticket, all delete manifests (S3 delete markers), audit logs from our control plane showing who executed each job, and the final-erase-report PDF. HSM/KMS key rotation: we rotate any tenant-specific envelope keys after erase and log the rotation event; we can provide key-rotation-audit-<ticket-id>.log (note: we do not hand over HSM key material).

Attachments for you: region-anchoring-diagram.pdf, tenant-wipe-checklist.xlsx, runbook-dedicated-erase-v2.md

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

We also need a short example artifact (sanitized) so our auditors can validate format. If you can provide a redacted final-erase-report and one storage-delete-manifest sample that would be ideal.

Best,
Alice
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Alice — thanks, will do. Quick answers: delete manifests are retained for 180 days by default for audit purposes (we can adjust per contract). For opt-in cross-region backups the wipe workflow will include replica deletion as part of Step 3, but we log replica targets and may schedule replica purges which can extend the completion time by 24–72 hours depending on cloud provider throttles; we will note that in the SOW.

Next steps: 1) I will upload a redacted final-erase-report and a sample storage-delete-manifest to the Drive link and grant your security team view access (by EOD PST). 2) Marissa will add the opt-in replica behavior and retention window to the SOW language for signature. 3) Dev will confirm the ticket-id format we return and the DocuSign anchor flow.

Marissa — can you confirm when SOW updates will be ready? Dev — can you post the sample artifacts to the Drive folder and copy Alice?

Thanks,
Kimberly
